ach_sub: EuroCorp-3 reactor trials. Every unlocked achievement grants bonus Biolab points.
daily_modal_sub: Daily seeded run with fixed rules, mutators, and a Biolab bonus reward.
daily_what_desc: Each day generates a challenge with a starting genome and special mutators. Complete the goal to earn +{pts} Biolab points.
w_name_ring: Ring of Death (close your tail loop)
biome_fx_flow_toast: BIOME RULE: CURRENT - the bloodstream pulses and shoves your body
biome_fx_ribs_toast: BIOME RULE: RIB SHADOWS - the swarm is faster inside the bands, you are slower
biome_fx_wind_toast: BIOME RULE: SPORE WIND - gusts push souls and your body
biome_fx_slick_toast: BIOME RULE: SLICK INERTIA - movement ramps up, knockback lingers
biome_fx_tide_toast: BIOME RULE: FRACTAL TIDES - the wave speeds up everything alive
modal_win_sub: You became the mind of the Macro-Leviathan — itself just a molecule inside EuroCorp-3. Every new run is a new universe.
biolab_sub: Persistent modules across runs. Points are earned from survival and kills. Toggle unlocked modules on/off anytime (limit: {max} active).
biolab_limit_toast: BIOLAB: {max}/{max} limit reached — disable an active module first
codex_sub: Catalog of swarm organisms, DNA strains, and Great Hybrids in EuroCorp-3 reactor.
codex_unknown_lore: Biological specimen not yet cataloged. Encounter or evolve it in combat.
help_b1_p: Your tail is your body, biomass, and primary melee weapon. Movement burns segments; DNA orbs restore length. If your tail bottoms out while idle, starvation drains HP.
help_b2_p: Loop your tail path around enemies. The closed polygon collapses instantly, crushing everything inside (including Spore Cocoons). Longer tail = higher ring damage.
help_b3_p: Shift or Right-Click — burst smoothly through enemies with brief invulnerability and a dense spore trail.
help_b4_p: Space — drop a toxin beacon at cursor (15s cooldown). Weapons unlock gradually by level (Lv. 3, 4, 5, 7 and 13; max 3 equipped), and Spore Cysts only drop while moving.
help_d1_p: Vermis (whip & tail capacity), Chimera (plasma & blasts), Mycelium (spores & mind-control), Symbiont (magnet & speed).
help_d2_p: Reach DNA Level 3 in two branches to unlock fusion cards: Plasma Leviathan, Ouroboros Parasite, Phase Serpent, Spore Reactor, Ion Colossus, Psi-Web.
help_d3_p: Fill the biomass bar to 100% and slay the Scale Titan. The world expands, palettes shift, and whip damage permanently rises by +35%.
help_d4_p: Pathologies (crimson border) grant huge power with harsh drawbacks. Proto-Organelles add autonomous defense systems.
help_w1_p: Your own strain boosts speed (+25%) and regenerates tail. Hostile strain melts tail 1.8x faster. Each Scale shifts the biome substrate palette.
help_w2_p: Hold the zone around a tower clear of enemies to fill it with your energy and gain buffs (Generator +HP, Amplifier slows melt & +dmg, Magnet +pickup, Mutagen +card, Incubator +XP). When you leave, monsters try to reclaim your towers! 2+ owned towers form a neural web.
help_w3_p: Corner Petri dish tracks swarms, elites, Wardens, Titans, bio-towers (including raid alerts), and anomalies: Acid Tide, Spore Cocoon, and Mitosis Bloom.
help_w4_p: Rapid DNA orb pickups build Symbiotic Resonance up to x3.0 XP and biomass. Biolab modules can be toggled on/off anytime (4 active slot limit).
settings_flashes_hint: Softens or disables damage light pulses
settings_parallax_hint: Out-of-focus bokeh cells and floating plankton
settings_quality_hint: Particle swarm density and bloom post-processing
webgpu_required_desc: Simulating 120,000 Physarum slime mold agents requires WebGPU Compute Shaders.
webgpu_required_hint: Recommended: Chromium / Chrome 113+, Edge 113+, or Firefox with dom.webgpu.enabled enabled.
hybrid_plasma_leviathan_desc: Flame Serpent: Ring of Death deals 4x damage and annihilates standard foes inside
hybrid_ouroboros_desc: Living Incubator: foes slain by your tail fuse into living segments
hybrid_phase_serpent_desc: Grav-Whip: tail intercepts enemy projectiles and hurls them back
hybrid_spore_reactor_desc: Plague Supernova: Nova infects foes with spores that chain-detonate on death
hybrid_ion_colossus_desc: Tesla Web: electro-orbs arc lightning to nearby enemies
hybrid_psi_web_desc: Overmind: faster node capture and owned bio-nodes fire laser beams
hunt_hint: Hybrid hunt mode: reach 3+3 DNA levels in both branches to unlock the golden fusion card
scale_1_sub: EuroCorp-3 probe reactor: a biomass droplet stirs in the vial
scale_2_sub: Petri dish: fields of nutrient agar, the first hunting grounds
scale_4_sub: Host lymph: whitish rivers carrying intruders to the filters
scale_5_sub: Organ depths: black bile and bioluminescent suspension
scale_6_sub: Host skeleton: rib frames and cartilage arches echo every heartbeat
scale_7_sub: Nervous system: the host's thoughts flare like a storm
scale_8_sub: Outside at last: riding the exhale, the organism leaves the body and sees the stars of Ξ-9
scale_9_sub: Ξ-9 surface: forests of spores kilometers tall, and they sing
scale_10_sub: Oxidized wastes: the iron of dead colonizer ships
scale_11_sub: Hemisphere crust: magma has exposed the planet's memory
scale_12_sub: Ice mantle: permafrost keeps the civilizations of the past
scale_13_sub: Upper atmosphere: drifting spores weave living clouds
scale_14_sub: Sky rupture: auroral storms rewrite the DNA of everything alive
